newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products quiet as traders eye futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products quiet as traders eye futures.

text.p: NWE oil products stagnated in quiet trade early on Wednesday with many traders sidelined in anticipation of further losses in underlying IPE benchmark futures.
July IPE gas oil was trading 75 cents lower at $159.50 a tonne while Brent was called to come in 10 to 15 cents lower.

Gas oil eased in line with the futures losses but premiums were little changed with heating oil barges talked around July IPE -25 cents/flat fob ARA for prompt delivery and July IPE flat/+50 cents fob ARA for delivery into July.
Fuel oil was little changed with high sulphur fuel oil barges trading at $82.50 and $83 early on and then talked in the $83/$84 range. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
